_notes.fusion_weights: Quick Scan's input, keyed 'composite' (renamed from the historically mislabeled 'fakespot' — the quick-scan input is the badge's composite calibrated ai_likelihood_score, which may itself be DeBERTa-authoritative when that path fires, NOT a raw fakespot detector score; there is no isolated raw-fakespot signal available at this call site), used alone at weight 1.0 — the only detector available on the worker without Modal. This matches tier_authority's validated '0.40 * composite' input on the fused scale. Deep Scan (2-detector) uses 0.60 deberta_large / 0.40 composite per spec D10/§4 (owner-commissioned reversal: DeBERTa-large becomes primary once calibrated). These 2-detector-path weight values ARE live spec numbers, not invented; only the key label changed — weights themselves are unchanged and gate-validated (poc/calibration/v7_fused_gate_result.json).
_notes.deep_scan_3detector_inert: OU-Advacheck ('deep_scan_3detector_inert', 0.45/0.35/0.20) is DATA ONLY and NOT wired into any active code path. Per spec §4, OU-Advacheck is 'on hold' pending verification it was not one of the two candidates already rejected in the June 2026 fakespot evaluation (one inverted, one GPT-2-era). detector_fusion.py (not yet built) must never select this key until that verification + a separate SCoCESLE calibration pass clears it.
_notes.category_weights: CORRECTED 2026-07-03: the values originally written here were fabricated by a subagent that had no visibility into the source spec (draftproof_authorship_clarity_breakdown_tech_spec_v2.md — a file the user attached to the chat, never committed to this repo, so a fresh subagent with zero conversation context genuinely could not see it). These are now the LITERAL formula weights transcribed from that spec's §14.1-14.4 ('starter formula'), embedded verbatim as data per V7 spec §6/D4 (docs/draftproof_v7_authorship_clarity_spec.md). Each entry carries a 'direction' field: 'direct' means use the signal value as-is; 'inverse' means use (1 - signal_value) — the v2 formulas mix both (e.g. student_owned uses '1 - calibrated_detector_score', ai_generated_like uses specificity_score inverted). Getting direction wrong silently flips an entire category's score, so category_scoring.py MUST read and apply this field, never assume direct. Each list sums to exactly 1.0 on the weight component alone (direction does not affect the sum-to-1 check). Still untuned defaults — tunable only via the MLflow validation harness per spec §9.
_notes.ai_paraphrased_variants: Per spec D9 / v2 §14.3: 'ai_paraphrased' has two formula variants selected by has_comparison_text. The with-comparison variant's only comparison-dependent term is meaning_preservation_score (NEW/unbuilt as of Phase 1A — inert placeholder until Phase 1C). paraphrase_pattern_score is NOT comparison-dependent (it's a MiniLM structural-reuse pattern signal, also NEW/unbuilt Phase 1C, but present in BOTH variants per the v2 formula) and semantic_drift is not part of the ai_paraphrased formula in v2 at all — do not add it. The without-comparison (fallback) variant is the v2 formula with meaning_preservation_score's 0.10 weight simply omitted (v2 does not redistribute it — fallback sums to 1.0 on its own smaller term set: 0.30/0.25/0.20/0.15/0.10).
_notes.flatness_thresholds: Verbatim from spec §6 / v2 §16 rule: if the gap between the top and second-place category share is under 0.10, confidence is forced to 'low'; if the top category share itself is under 0.35 (near-uniform distribution across all 4 categories), presentation is forced to 'mixed signals' rather than showing 4 specific numbers. These guard against the v2 draft's own near-uniform 19/26/27/28% example (spec D5).
_notes.esl_guard: Per spec §6 / v2 §18: kept as a runtime confidence cap (not a score suppressor) plus the binding SCoCESLE FPR gate on poc/detect/ changes (spec D8) — this config only carries the runtime-cap thresholds, not the corpus gate itself. esl_high_threshold=0.70 marks a paragraph/document as ESL-flagged; ai_generated_damping=0.85 multiplicatively damps ai_generated_like_raw when ESL-flagged (never fully zeroes it — damping, not suppression); detector_disagreement_confidence_cap_threshold=0.25 means disagreement above that value alone triggers a confidence cap; esl_disagreement_cotrigger_threshold=0.60 means when ESL score exceeds 0.60 AND the disagreement trigger also fires, confidence_cap_value ('low') is force-applied regardless of other confidence signals.
_notes.display_bands: Strong/Some/Little/None banding for the normalized per-category share (spec §6.1). strong_min=0.5 (majority share), some_min=0.25 (meaningfully present), little_min=0.10 (weak but non-trivial); anything below little_min displays as 'None'. These are Phase-1A display-only edges — exact percentages remain internal/API-only until the §12 validation set clears calibration error targets (spec D5).
_notes.deep_scan_calibration: Per poc/calibration/v7_deberta_academic_baseline.json (checkpoint desklib/ai-text-detector-academic-v1.01 via Modal, calibrated 2026-07-04): the naive whole-document score from this checkpoint is USELESS at any reasonable threshold — its distribution is compressed near 1.0, so the production-convention SENT_THRESHOLD=0.99 gave a 68% FPR on human ESL essays when applied doc-level. Calibration was instead done at SENTENCE granularity, mirroring poc/detect/deberta_signal.py's SENT_THRESHOLD/DOC_FLOOR_PCT threshold-proportion design (see that file's module docstring for why averaging/isotonic calibration was rejected there too): each essay is split into sentences (poc.detect.deberta_windowing.split_sentences — the same splitter deberta_signal.py uses), each sentence is scored independently via Modal, and the document signal is proportion = fraction of sentences scoring >= sent_threshold. The swept threshold_sweep entry 'sent>=0.999_docfloor>=0.3' was selected: sent_threshold=0.999, doc_floor=0.3, giving fpr_higher_pct=6.5, fpr_lower_pct=5.3, parity_gap_pct=-1.2, tpr_ai_pct=100.0, sentence_auc_ai_vs_human=0.929 (n=139 higher-proficiency essays, 133 lower-proficiency essays, 65 AI texts). doc_floor=0.3 is a RELIABILITY floor, not a score floor: a proportion below it means too few sentences crossed sent_threshold to trust the reading, so pipeline_bridge.py must flag it as low-reliability (uncertainty_flags) rather than silently treating it as a small-but-meaningful signal or zeroing it out.
_notes.deep_scan_display_bands: User-facing 'Deep-scan AI estimate' tier bands for the sentence-proportion signal, mirroring poc/detect/deberta_signal.py's _band_for philosophy: NO 'green' band exists — a proportion below the reliability floor is 'insufficient evidence', never 'clean'. insufficient_below=0.3 is BY CONTRACT equal to deep_scan_calibration.doc_floor (the reliability floor; config.py enforces the equality). orange_min=0.5 and red_min=0.7 are presentational severity cutoffs, not independently calibrated verdict thresholds; they are anchored to poc/calibration/v7_deberta_academic_baseline.json's threshold_sweep at sent_threshold=0.999: 'sent>=0.999_docfloor>=0.5' measured fpr_higher_pct=0.7, fpr_lower_pct=0.8, parity_gap_pct=0.1, tpr_ai_pct=95.4 (a document at/above 0.5 is almost never a human ESL essay — sub-1% FPR — hence 'orange'); 'sent>=0.999_docfloor>=0.7' measured fpr_higher_pct=0.0, fpr_lower_pct=0.0, parity_gap_pct=0.0, tpr_ai_pct=76.9 (zero measured human FPR at/above 0.7 — hence 'red'). Between doc_floor (0.3, where measured FPR was 6.5%/5.3%) and 0.5 the signal is real but has non-trivial false-positive mass, so it displays as 'amber'.
_notes.tier_authority: Per the V7 fused-score authority re-base (2026-07-03, poc/calibration/v7_fused_gate_result.json — GATE PASS): fused_score = 0.40 * composite_score_0_100 + 0.60 * deep_scan_proportion_0_1 * 100. The fused scale beats the composite alone on every gate axis (overall FPR 2.9%->0.4% at the 50-point composite/48-point-equivalent operating point, AUC 0.755->0.9955). A cutoff sweep ON THE FUSED SCALE validated that the EXISTING tier cutoffs (32/48/65, previously tuned for the composite-only scale) carry over unchanged: at 32, FPR 5.9%/TPR 99.2%; at 48, FPR 0.4%/TPR 89.5%; at 65, FPR 0%/TPR 46%. These are the same cutoff numbers as poc/detect/'s existing amber/orange/red tier boundaries — carried over, not re-derived — because the sweep showed the fused scale preserves them. Tier bands: green below amber, amber [32,48), orange [48,65), red >=65. This section only takes effect when DRAFTPROOF_V7_TIER_AUTHORITY is truthy AND a real deep-scan proportion is available (fail-open otherwise per poc/detect_v7/pipeline_bridge.py's is_v7_enabled/is_deep_scan_enabled pattern).
_notes.category_weights_tuning: Tuned 2026-07-08 (detector-gated specificity split experiment; driver in scratchpad, transient/not committed). seed 45, 2000 Dirichlet trials + top-5 coordinate refinement, 70/30 stratified holdout, replayed offline over calibration/v12_validation/captures/signals_fused_v2.jsonl (captures derived from the fused path AFTER the split signals were added to the adapter). The split disambiguates the raw low_specificity criterion via the calibrated detector score: specificity_student_evidence = low_specificity*(1-detector), specificity_ai_evidence = low_specificity*detector (structural derivation in signal_adapter.py rows 9a/9b, not a tuned weight). student_owned now weights specificity_student_evidence and ai_generated_like weights specificity_ai_evidence; ai_assisted_polished keeps the raw specificity_score. Winner metrics (tune/holdout): false-AI 3.6%/0.0%, generated-like 80.4%/70.8%, ai_assisted_polished 85.2%/91.7%, macro 65.5%/65.6% — all four owner accuracy targets met. Class-level means (198-doc fused corpus) confirm monotone separation across student->polished->paraphrased->generated: student_ev 0.502/0.335/0.289/0.247, ai_ev 0.108/0.239/0.271/0.281. Supersedes the seed-42 promotion (2026-07-08). Do NOT touch tier_authority/fusion_weights/deep_scan_calibration/esl_guard/display_consistency_guard/flatness/display_bands.
_notes.paraphrase_mismatch_normalization: V8 Task 5 (2026-07-08): quantile-normalization bounds for the NEW paraphrase_mismatch derived signal (signal_adapter.py row 9c), the WINNER of the Phase A interaction study (poc/calibration/v12_validation/phase_a_interaction_study.json, corpus n=198). paraphrase_mismatch = quantile_norm(specificity_student_evidence * calibrated_detector_score) = content-humanness x surface-AIness. That raw product scored effective AUC 0.7202 for ai_paraphrased_vs_ai_generated_like (the pair the ai_paraphrased category historically confused, both above the 0.70 gate) with a clean ESL subgroup check (lower-vs-higher AUC 0.365, 20/20 coverage, no ESL false-positive skew). p10=0.0589 / p90=0.1623 are the study's raw-product percentiles; the adapter maps p through clamp01((p-p10)/(p90-p10)) because the raw range is compressed (p90 only 0.1623) and without spreading the signal could contribute at most ~0.16*weight, leaving the tuner unable to express it. The 0.20 starter weight in ai_paraphrased_without_comparison (existing entries scaled by 0.8 so the list still sums to 1.0) is a STARTER for the MLflow validation harness to finalize (spec §9) — the tuner owns the final weight, this block only shapes the [0,1] feature value. Do NOT hardcode p10/p90 in Python; config.get_paraphrase_mismatch_normalization reads them here.

display_consistency_guard._notes: Owner-approved companion to the 2026-07-08 category_weights re-tune (seed 42, see category_weights_tuning note above): post-rewire, 17/80 AI-generated docs in the §12 validation set (poc/calibration/v12_validation/false_ai_diagnosis.json) display 'student_owned' as their top V7 category share while the badge tier (fused-score-driven, untouched by this guard) correctly reads concerning/strong — a contradictory display (red tier + 'the writing looks student-owned'). Per project alignment principle 'guards ANNOTATE, never SUPPRESS' (CLAUDE.md), this does not change shares or primary_category; it reuses the existing mixed_signals presentation + primary_category_reliable=False mechanism (poc/detect_v7/breakdown_composer.py's flatness guard) plus an uncertainty_flags entry, applied in poc/detect_v7/pipeline_bridge.py::run_v7_breakdown where the badge tier is available. display_fallback._notes: V8 measured resolution (owner decision 2026-07-08, evidence poc/calibration/v12_validation/v8_frontier_result.json). The V8 tuning frontier proved ai_paraphrased cannot be separated from ai_generated_like on single-document evidence: acceptance required para>=0.40 AND polished>=0.65 AND macro>=~0.65 and NO operating point satisfies all three (binding wall: paraphrase_mismatch feature mean sits on the wrong side, polished 0.694 > paraphrased 0.644, so the tuner can only buy paraphrase wins by relabeling polished as paraphrased). Rather than assert a distinction the signal cannot support, the user-facing breakdown MERGES the two indistinguishable AI indicators into a single 'ai_transformed' display category. ADDITIVE, presentation-only: pipeline_bridge.py::run_v7_breakdown composes display_taxonomy/display_shares/display_primary from the merged shares while the four-way document_breakdown_raw/document_breakdown_bands/primary_category/guards stay byte-identical (retained for audit + the V8b paired-draft feature family that may later recover the separation). mode 'three_way' emits the display_* fields; mode 'four_way' is the forward-compatible off-switch (no display_* fields). config.py::get_display_fallback_config validates fail-loud (KeyError if missing; ValueError on unknown mode, unknown merged_from category, or a merged_display_category colliding with an existing four-way category name).
